essence: Effective recitation requires disciplined personal purity and a large number of repetitions.
The practitioner must provide food and honoraria to recipients in proportion to personal means.
The fire oblation is to be started the next day with diligent effort.
A wise practitioner must make one hundred and eight fire offerings every day.
After worship, brahmins must be respectfully satisfied in accordance with one's resources.
